game.name: Ridge Racer Unbounded (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Ridge Racer Unbounded is a racing game for Xbox 360 that takes you through the streets of a fictional American city called Shatter Bay. Skidding, sticking to your opponents and jumping will allow you to accumulate destructive energy. This will give you the opportunity to blow up elements of the scenery to create shortcuts or to trap your competitors.
